La mayoría del modelo, como el casco, se hizo a partir de cero, mientras que la parte del modelo como el cuerpo y la cara son respectivamente Mario 64 y Ocarina del Tiempo. Los clips de voz para Robocop son de Mortal Kombat 11 (Peter Weller), y sin embargo bastante divertido uno de los mods más silenciosos que he hecho.  

¡Disfruta del mod como disfruté haciéndolo!

Robocop c) Orión y MGM

Disclaimer: This mod requires Squishy6094's Character Select to function. In addition, this pack isn't affiliated with Render96 or any other project of a similar nature.

Here's a holiday treat: The N64 Mario Bros. right from the promotional magazines you've come to know and love return once again to embark on another adventure! Get your Nintendo 64 controllers ready for some classic N64 fun!

Included are a set of tailor-made models using advanced computer technology to bring you the best Mario 64 experience!
To see them in action, simply highlight the vanilla Mario and Luigi character slots and swap costumes with the Control Pad or C-Buttons depending on if you're in Grid or List View.
See Mario and Luigi emote based on their actions!


       
        


They also come with an additional costume each that features recolorable versions of the Mario Bros, complete with 5 preset palettes for each!
Come up with whatever wacky color schemes your heart desires!



That's not all! They also come with unique voicelines compiling the best of Martinet's performance from 1996-2006, many of which are in higher quality!

mods.name: Hide and Seek Lite
mods.author: Dan_SM64
mods.description:
A reimplementation of the original Hide and Seek mod which optimizes code and fixes bugs while retaining the original design. This was done purely as a coding practice to see how much the original mod could be polished. The script is roughly 24% smaller while containing the same design and feature set of the original, as well as fixing a handful of bugs and exploits.

Bugs Fixed:

Hiders becoming seekers out of nowhere.
Timer resetting when someone joins.
Cannon Timer not resetting properly.
Metal/Wing cap toggles reversed.
BLJ Prevention affecting backwards momentum outside of BLJs.
PU Prevention warping all players in level back to start.
Tagging during intermissions.
Splash text and sound effects playing outside of their intended design.


Changes:

Disabled All Dialogs.
Added Anti-Stall for Excessive Warping.
Added Anti-Stall for abusing Invincibility Frames.
Cannon Timer is displayed in the HUD.
Moved Splash Text to near the Top of the Screen.
Improved HUD/UI Text.


Credits:

Written by Dan
Original Hide and Seek Script by Super Keeberghrh and djoslin0
Support from "The tiger with no ears"


Disclaimer:
- Anyone is allowed to modify and republish this mod as they wish, as long as proper credit is given for the original works.

Esto se hizo puramente como una práctica de codificación para ver cuánto se podía pulir el mod original. El script es aproximadamente 24% más pequeño mientras contiene el mismo diseño y conjunto de características del original, así como fijar un puñado de errores y exploits.

Errores fijos:

Los escondites se convierten en aspirantes de la nada.
Timer reajustándose cuando alguien se une.
Cannon Timer no se reinicia adecuadamente.
Metal/Wing toggles revertidos.
BLJ Prevención que afecta el impulso atrasado fuera de BLJs.
PU Prevención derribando a todos los jugadores de nivel para empezar.
Etiqueta durante las intermisiones.
Esplash texto y efectos de sonido jugando fuera de su diseño previsto.


Cambios:

Discapacitados todos los diálogos.
Añadido Anti-Stall for Excessive Warping.
Añadido Anti-Stall para abusar de los marcos de invincibilidad.
Cannon Timer se muestra en el HUD.
Movido Texto de Splash a cerca de la parte superior de la pantalla.
Mejorado HUD/UI Texto.

mods.name: Slide Kick Rollout on B
mods.author: ZeelaTunes
mods.description:
When sliding on the ground after a dive, Mario can use either the A button or the B button to roll out of the dive.

With slide kicks, however, you could only roll out with the A button.

This is a simple script that allows Mario to roll out of a slide kick's slide with either A or B, making it consistent between both types of slides.

description_translations.es:
Cuando se desliza sobre el suelo después de una inmersión, Mario puede utilizar el botón A o el botón B para salir de la inmersión.

Con las patadas de diapositivas, sin embargo, sólo se puede salir con el botón A.

Este es un script sencillo que permite a Mario salir de la diapositiva de una patada deslizante con A o B, lo que lo hace consistente entre ambos tipos de diapositivas.
description_translations.pt_BR:
Ao deslizar no chão após um mergulho, Mario pode usar o botão A ou o botão B para sair do mergulho.

Com chutes de slide, no entanto, você só poderia rolar para fora com o botão A.

Este é um script simples que permite Mario rolar para fora de um slide kick 's slide com A ou B, tornando-o consistente entre ambos os tipos de slides.
description_translations.fr:
Lorsqu'il glisse au sol après une plongée, Mario peut utiliser le bouton A ou le bouton B pour sortir de la plongée.

Avec des coups de pied, cependant, vous ne pouvez rouler avec le bouton A.

Il s'agit d'un script simple qui permet à Mario de sortir de la diapositive d'une diapositive avec A ou B, ce qui la rend cohérente entre les deux types de diapositives.
description_translations.it:
Quando si scivola a terra dopo un'immersione, Mario può utilizzare il pulsante A o il pulsante B per uscire dall'immersione.

Con scivolo calci, tuttavia, si potrebbe solo rotolare fuori con il pulsante A.

Questo è un semplice script che permette a Mario di uscire dalla diapositiva di un calcio di scorrimento con A o B, rendendolo coerente tra entrambi i tipi di diapositive.

mods.name: [CS] Kat GR
mods.author: Lightson
mods.description:
Commission for Ceeington!

Custom Moveset:

-Gravity Slide: Crouch and attack while moving (replaces slide kick)

-No height damage

-Press your assigned "Y" button to change your gravity style: Normal -> Lunar -> Jupiter

-Normal: default gameplay

-Lunar Style: lower weight, lower speed doing gravity slide, stay/walk on water (she doesn't sink)

-Jupiter Style: heavier weight, fast speed doing gravity slide, touch damage (can destroy boxes & weak enemies)

Credits:
-CS Template File by Squishy
-Gravity Slide code based on Shield Surfing action from Link HotPS by Violet & ProfeJavix
-Touch damage based on Birdo's attack from Extra Chars Plus by ULTRA BROS TEAM
-Walk on water code by PeachyPeachsm64, modified by me

This Mod requires Character Select to work!

-Normal: juego predeterminado

-Lunar Estilo: menor peso, menor velocidad haciendo diapositiva de gravedad, stay/walk en el agua (no se hunde)

- Estilo Júpiter: peso más pesado, velocidad rápida haciendo diapositiva de gravedad, daño táctil (puede destruir cajas & enemigos débiles)

description_translations.fr:
Commission pour Ceeington !

Déplacement personnalisé & #160;:

-Gravité Diapositive: Croupe et attaque en mouvement (remplace le coup de glissade)

- Pas de dommages en hauteur

-Appuyez sur votre bouton "Y" pour changer votre style de gravité : Normal -> Lunaire -> Jupiter
